name: Mist Resonance without a Melody this turn: allies still assign combat damage with their power
notes: Same as the Harmonize fixture but no Melody card was activated this turn, so Harmonize is off: the Dungeon Guide still assigns 1 (its power) even though Mist Resonance gave it +1 LIFE.

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] Harmonize -- If you've activated a Melody card this turn, allies you control assign damage with their life stat instead of power stat until end of turn.
